verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no policy or documentation about whether customer data flows through Fivetran (or its AI-context features) are used to train AI models, nor any opt-out/consent mechanism for such use. While Fivetran does reference enabling AI tools via a 'unified context layer' (fivetran-docs-7), there is no statement on AI training data usage or an opt-out control, so the capability is unevidenced.
